title: A tenant administrator changes the company's time zone
goal: The tenant's administrator opens the settings, chooses another time zone for the company and finds it kept after a reload, sets it back to the platform's time zone, and reaches the company's custom fields in the same settings; a colleague who may only view settings sees them read-only.

actors.description: Operates the platform and acts inside a tenant only by impersonating one of its users.
Holds every permission of Company A, as the platform owner sees and acts while impersonating them.
May view Company A's users, units and settings and change nothing, as the platform owner sees while impersonating them.

preconditions: The end-to-end database was prepared in this run: Company A with Alex Morgan and Robin Lee, and its time zone pinned to the platform's, as every tenant's is when it is set up.

steps.intent: Sign in and impersonate Company A's administrator
steps.outcome: The platform owner sees Company A as its administrator does.
The General panel shows the company's time zone, the same as the platform's, which it names beside it.

steps.intent: Search the time zones, choose another one from the keyboard and save
steps.outcome: The panel says the company's time zone is now the chosen one.
The panel shows the chosen time zone and offers the platform's back.

steps.intent: Open the Custom fields panel of the settings
steps.outcome: The panel lists the company's own fields beside the global field.

steps.intent: Set the time zone back to the platform's
steps.outcome: The company's own time zone is the platform's again, kept through a reload.

steps.intent: Open the settings as a colleague who may only view them
steps.outcome: The time zone shows and cannot be changed, and there is nothing to save.

completion: Company A's time zone was changed by its administrator and kept through a reload, then set back to the platform's time zone as the company's own.
A user who may only view settings cannot change them.
